draft.summary: Accept pastry orders only with 48 hours' notice
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Story (created as Task; this Jira project has no Story type).

Pastry orders need advance notice. Decided in the 2026-10-01 product daily.

## User Story
As the bakery, I want pastry orders accepted only with 48 hours' notice, so that the rule agreed on 2026-10-01 is applied.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Order with enough notice** (Happy path) — A customer places a pastry order with at least 48 hours' notice. Expected: the order is accepted.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Open question: what a customer sees when ordering with less notice.
